sql: SELECT co.AD_Callout_ID, co.Name, mo.Classname, col.ColumnName, col.AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Callout co JOIN AD_Column col ON col.AD_Callout_ID = co.AD_Callout_ID JOIN AD_Tab t ON col.AD_Table_ID = t.AD_Table_ID LEFT JOIN AD_Model_Object mo ON mo.AD_Callout_ID = co.AD_Callout_ID WHERE t.AD_Window_ID = $1 ORDER BY co.AD_Callout_ID, col.AD_Table_ID, col.ColumnName
